snippet.title: Hellbrella | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
A fast-paced Aerial Roguelite Hack and Slash where Insane Combos and pure aggression are all that stand between you and death. Step into the paws of a Raincoat Cat and face an infernal journey with nothing but your Umbrella as a Weapon! 🐱☂️

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3510060/Hellbrella/
